descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S07 Extraction edges: 0 labs (only 'pending'), 1 lab, 20 labs, serial values of one lab

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 Fields the prior note does not contain stay empty and are never filled with invented values: no invented lab, normal, unit, completed result or diagnosis, and no narration of documentation status. (TFA-92591 AC 4; UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress
  • U2 From an explicitly pasted or photographed prior note, the background, active issues, imaging and diagnostic tests are extracted correctly and update that patient's chart. (UAT TC-13; TFA-92591 AC 1; TFA-92591 How it works 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress
  • U4 Labs from a prior note are stored as prior values with that note's date, never as today's panel. Today's value of the same lab is not overwritten, and no prior lab is shown or counted as today's. (UAT TC-13; TFA-92591 AC 1; TFA-92591 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Four synthetic prior notes at the edges of the lab list

When Send each through ai/parsing:extractPriorNote

Then B-0: labs empty (a pending draw is not a result) and no narration of documentation status. B-1: exactly one lab with its value. B-20: all 20 labs with exact values, none dropped or merged. B-serial: the latest creatinine, with the stated comparison as its trend and no value invented between them

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Checks per fixture (prior-note-ai vocabulary, see S06). Counted with S06 as AI-check evidence; failures are quoted

Where it ran: dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S07 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-13.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
